summary: XP bar with a hot leading edge; when it overflows the bar flashes and the level number bursts into pixels that reassemble as the next level.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Level, rounded to a whole number of at least 0. Changing it updates the number in place without firing `levelup`.

events.name: gain
events.description: Fires on each gain with the amount added.

events.name: levelup
events.description: Fires when the bar overflows, with the new level.

methods.description: Adds XP, fires `gain` and animates the bar; overflow carries into the next level. A value that is not a positive number is ignored.

accessibility: The level is text ("Level 7"). The bar canvas has `role="progressbar"` with `aria-label="XP towards level 8"`, `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemax` and `aria-valuetext` such as "196 of 240 XP", updated on every gain and level-up.
The status line is an `aria-live="polite"` region that announces "Level N reached".
"+40 XP" and "+180 XP" are native buttons.
motion: With reduced motion, the bar jumps to the new value and the level number changes in place without bursting into pixels; sparks are skipped.
notes: XP starts at 196 and is not configurable. Each level needs 100 + 20 x level XP, so level 7 needs 240.
The level number is set in the monospace font; during a level-up its pixels are sampled from the text and hand back to it once they settle. The canvas is 104px tall.

data.note: The starting XP of 196 is invented; only `level` can be set and `gain()` adds to it.
